title: MAATlab — Cyber-Physical Architecture & Urban Systems
text: MAATlab develops closed-loop cyber-physical systems that bridge urban/environmental telemetry, AI simulation, spatial computing, and 1:1 physical prototyping.

title: MAATlab — Cyber-Physical Architecture & Urban Systems
text:
System Loop

Sensing & Urban Telemetry: Capturing messy real-world inputs—from 360° street-level affective perception to LiDAR scans of irregular local materials[cite: 1].
AI & Parametric Simulation: Training multimodal vision-language models (MLLMs) and surrogate structural/climate solvers[cite: 1].
Mixed Reality Alignment: Projecting holographic assembly, force vectors, and fabrication tolerances onto physical workspaces[cite: 1].
1:1 Technological Demonstrators: Validating digital workflows through sensor-instrumented physical prototypes and field deployments[cite: 1].
